title: fetch.py shows a role-less navigation aside inside <main> as page content (kali docs menu, docker table of contents, slsa on-this-page)
goal: The HTML-to-text reduction in _tools/fetch.py keeps an <aside> inside <main> or <article> only when it has data-type=sidebar (BG-nr2mv4si g1, changed by the operator after the SP-5bvg4tnl review), so a role-less aside that holds site navigation or an on-this-page list (kali.org docs card, docs.docker.com table of contents, slsa.dev on this page) is skipped again, while the sre.google book sidebars stay kept; kb/_self/web-sources.md states the rule. Found by the SP-5bvg4tnl review (gap 1).
